routed_defects.title: ctl-escape-prefix (ESCAPES_LANE only for a literal '../' prefix) scores 20/20
routed_defects.remediation: not an instrument fix: the frozen probe needs an interior-'..' sub-run (next round); this round the kill rule decides

routed_defects.title: ctl-read-then-cap (cap after read) scores 20/20; 'refused before it is read' is unobservable to the probe
routed_defects.remediation: next-round arm: a receipt that is a sparse multi-GiB file or /dev/zero-backed size claim with an RSS/time bound

routed_defects.title: symlinked PARENT of --dir is followed (only the last component is lstat'ed)
routed_defects.remediation: after lstat: if (realpathSync(dir) !== dir) throw FailClosed('SYMLINK_DIR', ...)

routed_defects.title: lstat then path-based readdir/readFileSync: a concurrent writer bypasses RECEIPT_TOO_LARGE, SYMLINK_RECEIPT and SYMLINK_DIR
routed_defects.remediation: fd = openSync(path, O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK); fstatSync(fd) isFile && size<=cap; read at most cap+1 bytes from fd; for the dir: re-check realpathSync(dir)===dir after the loop

routed_defects.title: an invisible prefix (UTF-8 BOM, NUL) hides a field line from ^key= matching: duplicate cmd= unseen, displayed rev= ignored
routed_defects.remediation: fail closed (RECEIPT_UNREADABLE) on a leading BOM or any NUL/C0 byte other than \t\r\n; or count /^[^\n]*?(cmd|rev|tool_sha256)=/m

routed_defects.title: an absolute alias of the lane (symlink, /proc/self/cwd) is 'external' and hashed from the dirty worktree
routed_defects.remediation: classify by realpathSync(abs) against realpathSync(lane); inside -> git read; and assert external=0 in the round's close after-state

routed_defects.title: external-instrument read has no type/size guard: /dev/zero OOMs, a FIFO hangs, no verdict line
routed_defects.remediation: statSync(abs): require isFile() and size <= a cap before readFileSync (or open O_NONBLOCK + fstat)

routed_defects.title: receipt file names and tokens are printed raw: a newline in a name forges a second RECEIPT_BIND line
routed_defects.remediation: JSON.stringify file names/tokens in detail and first=, or fail closed on names outside [A-Za-z0-9._-]
